R508.note: Drops sh -c for exec.Command("convert", args...) so both paths are single literal argv entries; contract preserved, and the residual leading-dash option-injection angle is acknowledged rather than hidden.

R509.note: HttpUtility.JavaScriptStringEncode is the right encoder for a JS string-literal sink (it also escapes < and > as </>, so the extra Replace("/", "\/") is redundant but harmless); output otherwise unchanged.

R510.note: extractall(workspace_dir, filter="data") rejects traversal, absolute paths and escaping symlinks on the stated 3.11.x runtime; the added with-block only closes the handle earlier and legitimate template bundles extract as before.

R511.note: Direct PING.EXE launch via ArgumentList closes the cmd.exe injection, but the added RFC 1123/canonical-IP allowlist is a new restriction that rejects inputs the original accepted (underscored internal hostnames, IPv6 zone ids, non-canonical IPs) - stated, so 1 not 0.

R512.note: unserialize(..., ['allowed_classes' => false]) keeps the legacy wire format so pre-migration rows still load while blocking object instantiation; the stated false-to-[] fallback turns a decode failure from a TypeError into an empty cart, which is disclosed and blocks no legitimate caller.

R513.note: ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment(autoescape=True) is the correct Jinja2 API for caller-authored template source; contract preserved (same from_string/render flow, user and campaign still reachable), and the 3.1.6 sandbox-bypass floor is called out.

R514.note: Replaces format(param, obj) with write(encodeForHtml(param)); the hand-rolled encoder covers the body-context characters correctly and the removal of Formatter interpretation is stated plainly (obj is left as a dead local).

R515.note: Rendering the description as a JSX text child lets React escape it; the whiteSpace: pre-wrap style is stated, though the div-to-p/className="description" markup swap is not mentioned (cosmetic, no legitimate use blocked).

R516.note: Adds length > buffer_len - offset after the existing offset check (no overflow since offset <= buffer_len is already proven); matches the contract exactly, including offset == buffer_len with length 0.

R517.note: push_back closes the out-of-bounds write into packet, but the contract asks that count > fields.size() be rejected or reported and the fix leaves fields[i] unguarded (still UB on that same line); the omission is stated openly as out of scope.

R518.note: th:utext to th:text on the same expression routes the note through Thymeleaf's default HTML escaping; nothing else in the fragment, context binding or return changes.

R519.note: A fixed command-to-handler map is the right shape for a call_user_func_array sink, but the fix invents two placeholder handlers (help/status) and rejects every other command the bot previously dispatched; stated as a required follow-up, so 1.

R520.note: finfo MIME sniff + getimagesize + server-derived extension and random name keep .php/.phtml off the executable path; the image-only restriction is what an avatar sink calls for and the rename, mkdir and move_uploaded_file error check are all stated (note nothing records the new random name for later lookup, same as the original which recorded nothing).

R521.note: Static SQL with a ? placeholder and (customer_id,) bound via sqlite3's parameter argument; connection, cursor, fetchall and response shape unchanged.

R522.note: getOrDefault(sku, 0) makes an absent reservation resolve to zero, exactly the contract's no-reservation case; an explicitly null-valued entry would still NPE, which the write-up acknowledges.
